name: wiki-llm-mcp
description: Lets Claude read, search and maintain a folder of Markdown notes. Every change is a Git commit, and notes cannot be deleted.
long_description:
Point it at an Obsidian vault or any folder of Markdown notes. Claude can read and search the pages, create new ones, edit them and move them while keeping links valid. Every change is a Git commit of its own, your uncommitted edits are saved first, and there is no delete tool.

The folder is prepared on the first start: it becomes a Git repository and gains `raw/`, `wiki/`, `WIKI.md` (the rules Claude follows, which you can edit) and a generated `WIKI-INDEX.md`. Existing notes stay where they are.

Requires `git` on this computer.

vault.title: Folder of notes
vault.description: Your Obsidian vault, or the folder that holds your Markdown notes (it may be empty). It becomes a Git repository: choose the folder of notes itself, not your home folder.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the Markdown pages of the vault

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one page and its revision

tools.name: apply_changes
tools.description: Create, edit, append to, update or move pages, in one Git commit
